mainEntity.name: How much does a preconstruction consultation cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Initial discovery discussions are typically complimentary, while comprehensive preconstruction services involving formal estimating, site visits, and constructability reviews are structured as an agreed-upon service agreement. The final scope depends on project size, existing site complexity, and whether you require detailed cost breakdowns, trade walk-throughs, or assistance with permit submittal packages. Investing in paid preconstruction planning often saves thousands of dollars during construction by identifying grading obstacles, utility issues, and structural inefficiencies before field work begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: Initial project reviews are usually complimentary, while detailed preconstruction services involving full estimating and site evaluations involve a professional fee.
